lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Good morning and welcome to Radio Tenerify — I'm Alex, here with Mia, and it is a gorgeous Wednesday out there.

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: It really is! Clear skies, around twenty degrees down in the south this morning — classic Tenerife doing what it does best.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Before we get into the fun stuff, we do want to take a moment — there have been some serious incidents across the Canary Islands over recent weeks and months, including tragic accidents and a fatal incident in the Las Verónicas area. Our thoughts are with everyone affected.

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: Absolutely. Please stay safe out there, look after each other. Now — on a brighter note, if you're in or near Santa Cruz this weekend, you are in for a treat.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Yes! The Urban Beach Festival is happening Saturday at the Port of Santa Cruz, with Beéle bringing his Borondo Tour to the island — and then Sunday, Kapo makes his very first Tenerife appearance over at the Palmetum car park.

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: Two big nights, back to back — definitely worth checking out the websites for tickets and details.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: That's it from us for now — enjoy this beautiful Wednesday, Tenerife. Take care of yourselves!
